message: You know those moments when you realize you’ve forgotten to prepare for something? I once showed up to a family gathering without a gift—talk about a comedy of errors! 😅 Being ready doesn’t just mean having supplies; it’s also about being financially prepared for unexpected bumps along the road. I found a great resource that helps us think ahead, so we can avoid those awkward moments and focus on what really matters—our loved ones. It’s a little reminder that a bit of planning can go a long way!
